verdict.rationale: Supabase markets every project as "a full Postgres database... 100% portable". It is open source, can be self-hosted via Docker Compose, and exposes storage through an S3-compatible protocol, which together support leaving with data in standard formats. Daily backups exist in the dashboard, but the evidence includes no documented end-to-end export workflow. missing for 10: an explicit documented full-project export procedure (database dump, auth users, storage objects), confirmation that backups are downloadable, and independent or hands-on evidence of a successful migration out.
